## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run type-check`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm audit` reviewed
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual testing completed where applicable

## Security, privacy, and data ownership

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private documents, or real user data are included.
- [ ] Authorization and ownership checks were reviewed for changed routes, actions, RPCs, and Storage paths.
- [ ] Database changes use a new timestamped migration and preserve RLS.
- [ ] Uploads retain signature, size, extraction, and resource limits.
- [ ] AI/provider changes retain bounded inputs, rate limits, and safe error handling.
- [ ] Required environment or Supabase/Vercel/Redis configuration is documented.

## UX and accessibility

- [ ] Arabic RTL and English LTR behavior was checked where relevant.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, and setup-required states are handled.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, focus states, contrast, and responsive layouts were considered.
